cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8...3.20)

set(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_VERSION 1)
if (BOOST_SUPERPROJECT_VERSION)
    set(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_VERSION ${BOOST_SUPERPROJECT_VERSION})
endif ()
project(boost_accumulators VERSION "${BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_VERSION}" LANGUAGES CXX)

set(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_IS_ROOT OFF)
if (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_IS_ROOT ON)
endif ()

option(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_MRDOCS_BUILD "Build the target for MrDocs: see doc/mrdocs.yml" OFF)

# Match boost::url: allow BOOST_SRC_DIR from cache or environment (MrDocs / Antora set this).
if (NOT DEFINED BOOST_SRC_DIR AND DEFINED ENV{BOOST_SRC_DIR})
    set(DEFAULT_BOOST_SRC_DIR "$ENV{BOOST_SRC_DIR}")
else ()
    set(DEFAULT_BOOST_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..")
endif ()
set(BOOST_SRC_DIR ${DEFAULT_BOOST_SRC_DIR} CACHE STRING "Boost source dir when running CMake from this directory")

# Dependencies (INTERFACE) — names used to pull Boost modular targets from the superproject.
set(BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCIES
    Boost::array
    Boost::assert
    Boost::circular_buffer
    Boost::concept_check
    Boost::config
    Boost::core
    Boost::fusion
    Boost::iterator
    Boost::mpl
    Boost::numeric_conversion
    Boost::numeric_ublas
    Boost::parameter
    Boost::preprocessor
    Boost::range
    Boost::serialization
    Boost::throw_exception
    Boost::tuple
    Boost::type_traits
    Boost::typeof
)

foreach (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCY ${BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCIES})
    if (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCY MATCHES "^[ ]*Boost::([A-Za-z0-9_]+)[ ]*$")
        set(_acc_lib ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
        # Boost superproject scans libs/<path>/CMakeLists.txt — numeric libs live under libs/numeric/*.
        if (_acc_lib STREQUAL "numeric_conversion")
            set(_acc_lib "numeric/conversion")
        elseif (_acc_lib STREQUAL "numeric_ublas")
            set(_acc_lib "numeric/ublas")
        endif ()
        list(APPEND BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_INCLUDE_LIBRARIES ${_acc_lib})
    endif ()
endforeach ()

set(BOOST_INCLUDE_LIBRARIES ${BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_INCLUDE_LIBRARIES})

# When configuring this library as the top-level project, add the Boost superproject so that
# all Boost:: targets resolve (required for MrDocs / compile_commands.json).
if (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_IS_ROOT)
    set(CMAKE_FOLDER Dependencies)
    if (NOT IS_ABSOLUTE ${BOOST_SRC_DIR})
        set(BOOST_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${BOOST_SRC_DIR}")
    endif ()

    set(BOOST_SRC_DIR_IS_VALID ON)
    foreach (F "CMakeLists.txt" "Jamroot" "boost-build.jam" "bootstrap.sh" "libs")
        if (NOT EXISTS "${BOOST_SRC_DIR}/${F}")
            message(STATUS "${BOOST_SRC_DIR}/${F} does not exist. Fallback to find_package.")
            set(BOOST_SRC_DIR_IS_VALID OFF)
            break ()
        endif ()
    endforeach ()

    if (BOOST_SRC_DIR_IS_VALID)
        if (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
            set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
        endif ()
        set(BOOST_EXCLUDE_LIBRARIES ${PROJECT_NAME})
        set(PREV_BUILD_TESTING ${BUILD_TESTING})
        set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the tests." FORCE)
        add_subdirectory(${BOOST_SRC_DIR} Dependencies/boost EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
        set(BUILD_TESTING ${PREV_BUILD_TESTING} CACHE BOOL "Build the tests." FORCE)
        set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_MODULE_PATH} "${BOOST_SRC_DIR}/tools/cmake/include")
    else ()
        find_package(Boost REQUIRED)
        foreach (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCY ${BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCIES})
            if (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCY MATCHES "^[ ]*Boost::([A-Za-z0-9_]+)[ ]*$")
                set(_dep_name ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
                if (NOT TARGET Boost::${_dep_name})
                    add_library(Boost::${_dep_name} ALIAS Boost::headers)
                endif ()
            endif ()
        endforeach ()
    endif ()
    unset(CMAKE_FOLDER)
endif ()

add_library(boost_accumulators INTERFACE)
add_library(Boost::accumulators ALIAS boost_accumulators)

target_include_directories(boost_accumulators INTERFACE include)

target_link_libraries(boost_accumulators INTERFACE ${BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_DEPENDENCIES})

# Single translation unit for MrDocs (mirrors boost::url): pulls in the umbrella header so the
# compilation database is small and fast while symbols match doc/mrdocs.yml input globs.
if (BOOST_ACCUMULATORS_MRDOCS_BUILD)
    file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mrdocs.cpp" "#include <boost/accumulators/accumulators.hpp>\n")
    add_library(boost_accumulators_mrdocs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mrdocs.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(boost_accumulators_mrdocs PUBLIC boost_accumulators)
    target_compile_features(boost_accumulators_mrdocs PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    return ()
endif ()

if (BUILD_TESTING AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory(test)
endif ()
